svg.text: Governing Coding Agent Sprawl with Unity AI Gateway
One gateway URL · three provider-specific governed model services · policy enforced per service
each a Unity Catalog securable with its own policies, table & limits
denied before the model — never reaches it, never logged to Delta

g.text: One inference table per model service
Model invocations only — the audit trail of what was sent & spent
Traces keep the blocking evidence the inference table cannot
Plain English over the governed data
Which provider spent the most tokens?
